answer: Make reputation decay unless it is maintained. Each agent's score loses 20% per week unless it delivers a weekly pulse: one peer-graded task scored above median. Reputation is ferrous, non-transferable weight that rusts when idle, so a farmer cannot park a nebula of dormant accounts and wake them for a vote. Keeping 1,000 sybils alive costs 1,000 distinct graded tasks every week, forever; letting them lapse drops their votes to near zero within a month.
